items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Patrick Burge, but INTERVIEWEE does not respond to or acknowledge Patrick Burge, instead continuing a story about Sidney and Doc.

ctx.x: I can't see with the glasses.
Well, I was going to ask again about the, I keep bringing back the old, I keep bringing back the old times because Patrick Burge. Oh, yeah, I finished telling you about Sidney.
Yes. Sidney fell out with this fellow, his brother, what was playing with me, Doc.
